pro_course_detail.description:
I can help you land your dream English job if you take my class. 


Your CV will be edited by me, and I will make it as clear as possible in English. You will learn all the possible questions you may encounter in an interview about your personality and work ethic in this lesson. 


As a result, you will:

1. Leave a lot more confident about your responses to your interview questions.

course_info.trial_description:
Hello and welcome! 您好，歡迎光臨！ 안녕하세요, 환영합니다! ¡Hola y bienvenidos!

In this trial lesson, we’ll get to know each other and create a personalized learning plan just for you. Here’s what to expect:

✅ Quick Introductions (5 minutes)
We'll start with a friendly chat to break the ice and get to know each other.

✅ Fun & Simple English Assessment (15 minutes)
I’ll ask you four key questions to understand your goals and current English level:
1️. Why are you learning English? (e.g., travel, work, exams, or just for fun!)
2️. How long have you been studying English?
3️. What are your goals? (e.g., speak fluently, improve pronunciation, or expand vocabulary.)
4️. What specific areas would you like to improve? (Pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary, fluency, etc.)
